baseline_suite runs three targeted importer tests while after_suite runs the new node test file, so the two arms are not a comparable pair; the done-when's 'importers add no failure against the base' is therefore not measured for the 45 head failures beyond the three ids reproduced, and the base arm is recorded as partial.
